title: Reviewers always run in the container; homes kept for diagnosis
summary: The factory container is now the only wall a reviewer runs behind. osf no longer probes for the container marker, no longer carries a per-agent sandbox check, and no longer falls back to codex's own `--sandbox read-only` mode: every reviewer is built with its in-container mode, so codex always runs with `--dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox`. In exchange, the reviewer's temporary home can be kept instead of deleted (`OSF_KEEP_REVIEW_HOME`), the CI workflow points `TMPDIR` at a mounted `out/reviewer-home` and uploads it as an artifact per reviewer job, and any seeded login file is removed from that home before it is kept.

lanes.subtitle: review.yml jobs
lanes.summary: Three reviewer jobs (codex, claude, opencode) each prepare a mounted out/ directory, run the review image, and now also upload the reviewer's kept home as an artifact.

lanes.label: osf CLI
lanes.subtitle: crates/osf
lanes.summary: The review runner builds a roster of reviewers, prepares a fresh home and command for each, runs the agent, and decides whether to keep or delete that home.

lanes.label: Reviewer agent
lanes.subtitle: codex / claude / opencode
lanes.summary: The agent process itself. Codex now always starts with its own sandbox disabled, because the container is the wall.

lanes.label: Run artifacts
lanes.subtitle: out/ on the runner
lanes.summary: Files the job leaves behind: the reviewer's answer JSON, and now the reviewer's home directory with its child output and session files.

nodes.label: review.yml
nodes.subtitle: three reviewer jobs + collector
nodes.summary: Each reviewer job creates out/reviewer-home, passes OSF_KEEP_REVIEW_HOME=1 and TMPDIR=/out/reviewer-home into the review container, and uploads the resulting home as an artifact named review-home-<agent>.

nodes.label: Review container
nodes.subtitle: REVIEW_IMAGE, /pr workdir
nodes.summary: The container the review runs in. It mounts out/ and the gitconfig, and now receives the two environment variables that keep and relocate the reviewer's home.

nodes.label: review-home artifact
nodes.subtitle: upload-artifact, if: always()
nodes.summary: The kept reviewer home, uploaded even when the job fails, so a reviewer's child output and session files survive for diagnosis. It is a record only; nothing reads it back.

nodes.label: answer JSON
nodes.subtitle: out/<agent>.json
nodes.summary: The reviewer's validated answer, uploaded as before. The collector job reads these to post the review.

nodes.label: osf review run
nodes.subtitle: reviewers::run_one
nodes.summary: Runs one reviewer: builds the roster, prepares a fresh home and command, runs the child, validates its answer. The sandbox pre-check is gone, so the child is now the first thing that runs.

nodes.label: Reviewer roster
nodes.subtitle: roster / Reviewer::from_agent
nodes.summary: Builds each reviewer from its agent definition. It no longer takes an in_container flag: read_only is simply the agent's in-container mode, and the sandbox_check field is gone.

nodes.label: AGENTS table
nodes.subtitle: crates/osf/src/agents.rs
nodes.summary: The static agent definitions. Codex's read_only is now None and its sandbox_check is removed; the Review struct no longer has a sandbox_check field at all.

nodes.label: RunHome
nodes.subtitle: fresh home + Drop
nodes.summary: The reviewer's temporary home. Its Drop now checks OSF_KEEP_REVIEW_HOME: when set it prints the path and leaves the directory in place instead of removing it.

nodes.label: forget_login
nodes.subtitle: removes seeded login paths
nodes.summary: Before a kept home is left behind, deletes each of the reviewer's login paths from it, so a seeded credential never rides out with the diagnostic record.

nodes.label: codex
nodes.subtitle: --dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox
nodes.summary: Codex now always runs with its own sandbox off. Its read-only mode and its `codex sandbox -- true` pre-check are both removed; the container is the wall.

nodes.label: claude
nodes.subtitle: file tools, no shell
nodes.summary: Claude's read-only mode is unchanged; it never had a sandbox check, so the removal of the check path does not alter how it runs.

nodes.label: opencode
nodes.subtitle: OPENROUTER_API_KEY
nodes.summary: Opencode's definition is untouched apart from the removed sandbox_check field, which was empty for it.

edges.label: docker run + OSF_KEEP_REVIEW_HOME, TMPDIR
edges.summary: The job now hands the container the two variables that decide whether the reviewer's home survives and where it lives.

edges.label: /osf-bin/osf review run
edges.summary: The container's entrypoint for a review.
The run builds its roster without consulting the machine for a container marker.
Each reviewer is derived from its agent definition; the in-container mode is now the only mode.
A fresh home is prepared for the reviewer, and its Drop decides keep-or-delete.

edges.label: bypass flag, no pre-check
edges.summary: Codex is started directly with its sandbox off; the sandbox pre-check that used to gate this call is gone.
When the home is kept, the seeded login paths are deleted from it first.

edges.label: out/reviewer-home
edges.summary: The kept home is what the workflow uploads as the diagnostic artifact.
The validated answer is still written to out/<agent>.json.

flows.title: One reviewer job, from workflow to kept home
flows.summary: How a single reviewer job now runs: the workflow seeds a mounted home and asks osf to keep it, osf builds the reviewer in its container mode, runs the agent, strips any seeded login, and the job uploads what is left.

messages.label: OSF_KEEP_REVIEW_HOME=1, TMPDIR=/out/reviewer-home
messages.note: The job creates out/reviewer-home and points the container's temporary directory at it, so the reviewer's home lands on the mounted volume.

messages.label: roster(root)
messages.note: No container probe: each reviewer is built with its in-container mode, and codex's read-only fallback is gone.

messages.label: fresh home + seeded login
messages.note: The home is created under TMPDIR and the reviewer's login paths are copied in when no credential is in the environment.

messages.label: codex exec --dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox
messages.note: The sandbox pre-check that used to run first is removed; the agent is the first child started.

messages.label: answer JSON
messages.note: The child's stdout is parsed and validated against the lens as before.

messages.label: forget_login(home, reviewer)
messages.note: Runs after the child exits and before the home is dropped, so a seeded credential is not left in a kept home.

messages.label: Drop: keep instead of remove
messages.note: With OSF_KEEP_REVIEW_HOME set, Drop prints the path and leaves the directory in place.

messages.label: upload-artifact review-home-<agent>
messages.note: Uploaded with if: always(), so the home survives even a failed review.
